  Do you add an app to the showcase? Keep the checklist below and tick each item.
  For a different change, delete this text and describe the change.

## Add an app to the showcase

- [ ] The pull request adds one file: `showcase/<your-app>.ts`.
- [ ] The app uses at least one `@rootnative/*` package.
- [ ] People can get the app now from at least one link in the entry.
- [ ] I own the app, or the owner agrees.
- [ ] I have the rights to each image.
- [ ] `yarn verify` and `yarn showcase:check` pass.
